coverage_notes.role: Bounded supplementary recall watch only; production collector/publisher remains authoritative.

WHO.notes: Direct WHO emergency and regional situation-report endpoints returned internal errors. WHO site-search index yielded older material but could not restore timely official coverage.

coverage_notes.targeted_searches_scope: civilian casualties, ambulance and hospital capacity, medical evacuations, displacement and shelter, WASH, food, aid crossings, detention/hostages, ceasefire negotiations and military operations with documented civilian impact
